map.按蜂箱的流蜜周期与开始日期排定摇蜜（取蜜）计划，生成摇蜜日历与提醒，辅助蜂场作业: Sequence the extraction plan by each hive's flow cycle and start date, generating an extraction calendar with reminders to help organise apiary work and forage scheduling.
map.下次摇蜜日 = 上次取蜜日 + 流蜜周期(天)；周期按 7~14 天校验: Next extraction day = last extraction day + flow cycle (days); check the cycle against 7~14 days
map.为每个蜂箱登记流蜜周期与起始日期，按「上次取蜜日 + 流蜜周期」递推下次摇蜜日并: Register the flow cycle and start date for each hive, roll forward the next extraction day as "last extraction day + flow cycle" and generate a calendar with reminders, avoiding extracting too early (which harms capping maturity) or too late (which causes honey to press on the brood). Data is stored in browser local storage (localStorage), pure front-end and never uploaded.
map.按蜂箱登记流蜜周期（7~14 天）与起始日期，推算每个蜂箱的下次摇蜜（取蜜）日期: Using each hive's flow cycle and start date, compute the next extraction date per hive.
map.多箱排期：汇总各箱摇蜜日生成日历，协调人手与摇蜜机，避免同一天多箱挤占。: Multi-hive scheduling: aggregate extraction days across hives into a calendar, coordinate labour and extractors, and avoid crowding several hives on one day.
map.跟踪取蜜记录与产量，按箱统计累计取蜜量，评估蜜源期供给与蜂群产能。: Track extraction records and output, accumulate extracted honey per hive and assess forage supply and colony productivity.

map.：5 月 20 日入场，流蜜周期设 10 天，则下次摇蜜为 5 月 30 日，依: : arrival on 20 May with a 10-day flow cycle gives next extraction on 30 May, then 9 June, 19 June. If capping is insufficient, delay 2~3 days manually to avoid extracting unripe honey that ferments.

map.流蜜周期设几天合适？: How many days should the flow cycle be?
map.以蜜源植物泌蜜节奏与封盖情况为准，常见 7~14 天。大流蜜期宜偏短（7~10: Follow the nectar flow rhythm of the forage plants and the capping status; 7~14 days is common. A strong flow season favours the shorter end (7~10 days) while scattered sources favour longer; the tool requires a value within 7~14 days.
map.各箱群势、王龄、入场时间不同，泌蜜与封盖进度并不一致。按箱排期可避免「一刀切」，: Colony strength, queen age and arrival time differ, so nectar flow and capping progress are not identical. Scheduling by hive avoids one-size-fits-all and reduces the risk of taking unripe honey or harming the brood.
map.数据会保存到服务器吗？: Is data saved to a server?
map.蜂箱与取蜜记录存于浏览器本地存储（localStorage），不上传服务器；清除: Hive and extraction records are stored in browser local storage (localStorage) and never uploaded; clearing browser data wipes them. Keep a separate backup of extraction records.
